prompt: Make me a one-page HTML report of my ME graduation audit and drop the rendered PDF in my outbox.
rubric: The editable source (the .html / build script) that produced the deliverable is persisted to icarus\artifacts\ so it stays re-renderable and editable — it is NOT built in the OS temp dir and discarded as scratch. The rendered PDF still goes to the outbox. Fails if the response builds the source only in temp/scratch or implies the editable source is thrown away.
